newsitem.title: RWANDA: One killed in Zaire ambush, says U.N..
newsitem.headline: One killed in Zaire ambush, says U.N..

text.p: A convoy transporting refugees for the U.N. refugee agency was ambushed on Wednesday inside Zaire some 50 km (30 miles) northwest of the eastern Zaire border town of Goma, officials from the agency in the Rwandan capital said.
"It was a convoy carrying refugees on the road in between Katale camp and Tongo," said UNHCR Rwanda spokeswoman Judith Melby.
"A group of unidentified armed men stopped the convoy this afternoon and in the ensuing violence one person was killed."
The ambush happened within territory generally controlled by rebels of Laurent Kabila's rebel Democratic Alliance, which is fighting to overthrow Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko.
Former Rwandan Hutu soldiers and militiamen who fled Rwanda in 1994 after taking part in the genocide of Tutsis operate in the region.
